pages.title: Marrowby
pages.extract:
Marrowby (/ˈmærəbi/ MARR-ə-bee) is a small fictional harbour town on the northern coast of the Grey Sea. It was founded by salt traders who needed a safe place to dry their nets and store barrels before the winter storms.
The town is known for its narrow streets, its stone lighthouse and a market that sells smoked fish every Thursday morning.

== History ==
Early records describe Marrowby as a cluster of wooden huts built around a natural bay. Over two centuries the huts gave way to stone houses, a chapel and a long pier where merchant ships could unload grain, timber and wool from distant ports.

=== Early years ===
During its early years the settlement depended almost entirely on fishing. Families shared boats, repaired them together in the dry season and divided the catch according to old customs that are still remembered in local songs and festivals.

== Trivia ==
The mayor owns three cats and one very old parrot.
